stem.text: An experiment was conducted to investigate the effect of temperature on the activity of the enzyme $\beta$-glucosidase. The enzyme was tested when in solution (free) and when immobilised in alginate beads.
The results are shown in the graph below.

stem.alt: Graph of beta-glucosidase activity in arbitrary units against temperature in degrees Celsius from 0 to 100, with two curves labelled free enzyme and immobilised enzyme.

stem.text: Which statement about the effect of immobilisation of $\beta$-glucosidase is correct?

A.text: It increases the kinetic energy of the enzyme.

B.text: It inhibits the activity of the enzyme.

C.text: It reduces the optimum temperature of the enzyme.

D.text: It stabilises the enzyme against denaturation.
